result.reason: The added Section 17(d) reaches the preferred position: it requires up to six months of transition assistance at Garman’s then-current rates, return of Sparkling’s data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent deletion with written certification. It applies upon any expiry or termination and leaves the existing termination rights and return obligations unchanged. The drafting is professional and appropriately targeted, though defining “Sparkling’s data” or using an existing defined term such as “Customer Data” would improve precision.
